## SEO Agent — AI Pulse (v4.9)
**Every day 06:30** (cron `30 6 * * *`), each website skipped on **its own cycle day** (`seo_cycles`: its local weekday in its time zone; Monday for a website with no cycle row), when its weekly AI Visibility run asks the same engines; the rotation counts the six other mornings from that day; and on demand (*Manual Run* `{ domain | site_id, email?, callback_url? }`). Per site with AI visibility and `ai_pulse` on (`seo_monitors`; default on): the whole question panel (`seo_ai_prompts`, no brand question) on **ChatGPT** and **Gemini** (the real chat interfaces) and **Google AI Mode** — $0.004 each, about $0.24 a day for 20 questions. AI answers change from one ask to the next; seven samples a week per question and engine give rates with a narrow 95% range and catch a real change within a day.
Shares *AI Requests* and *Parse AI Answers* with the weekly tracker (same node names). *Pulse Metrics* → one `seo_ai_daily` row per site and day (counts per engine / question / competitor / source; the weekly report adds them) + the answers (`seo_ai_answers`, run_kind pulse, kept 35 days). **Alerts only when something really changed** (z-test at 99% vs the past week, a business suddenly named in 30%+ of answers, a question where you were named first for 3 days and are now missing) → e-mail + callback `stage: ai_pulse`. Quiet days send nothing.
